title: hubspot-api-client raises AttributeError: 'HTTPResponse' object has no attribute 'getheader'
symptoms: Every HubSpot call fails right after a dependency refresh
DeprecationWarning about getheader on older urllib3
cause: The generated Python client calls HTTPResponse.getheader, which urllib3 2.6.0 removed. urllib3 2.6.1 restored it, so only that one release breaks the client.
fix: Exclude urllib3 2.6.0 in your requirements and upgrade to 2.6.1 or later.
